value.rationale: The factor beta is the principal forward containment invariant studied by the motivating papers, and their Theorem 1.7 identifies its sharp planar lower envelope. Regular polygons are canonical symmetric test bodies and were already singled out in the reverse direction. Showing that every odd regular polygon hits the forward lower envelope gives a natural infinite equality family, completes both directions for that family, and reveals a quartic approach to the symmetric value.
